method_notes: homeschool: level derived from HSLDA per-state 'at a glance' fields (notification, teacher qualifications, assessments) read 2026-11-13. HSLDA's own colour category is only shown graphically and could not be read, so levels follow the rubric: none = no notice; low = notice only; moderate = notice plus testing/evaluation, or a parent-diploma rule with no testing; high = approval/curriculum review, or parent qualifications plus testing.

carry: permitless list confirmed against Wikipedia 'Constitutional carry' (29 states). All remaining permit states are listed as shall-issue by handgunlaw.us (updated 2026-11-11) following NYSRPA v. Bruen (2022); the nine formerly may-issue states are flagged in carry_note.

right_to_farm: NALC confirms all 50 states have a statute (compilation dated 2022-04-15; provisions chart June 2023). Notes record only changes confirmed this session; DC has no right-to-farm statute.

rainwater: the FEMP regulations map and NCSL page are no longer online (404). Limited-volume states (CO, UT, NV) and rooftop-exemption states (OR, WA, TX) were confirmed against state statutes or agency pages; all other 'allowed' values rest on a secondary 50-state survey (Rainplan, 2026-03-18) and are lower confidence.
offgrid_note: filled only where a dated source was read (primalsurvivor.net state guides, 2022-2023); null elsewhere. Off-grid rules are mostly county-level.
income_tax_top_rate: Tax Foundation 2026 table, rates as of 2026-01-01; local income taxes excluded.

AL.name: Alabama
AL.homeschool_note: Notice via church school or private tutor option; no testing.

AK.name: Alaska
AK.homeschool_note: Homeschool statute needs no notice, testing, or qualifications.

AZ.name: Arizona
AZ.homeschool_note: One-time affidavit to county; no testing.
AZ.right_to_farm_note: 2021: mandatory fee award against bad-faith nuisance suits.
AZ.offgrid_note: Composting toilets allowed with permit; utilities add solar-owner fees (2023 source).

AR.name: Arkansas
AR.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.

CA.name: California
CA.homeschool_note: File private school affidavit; no testing.
CA.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; proper-cause ended after Bruen; no nonresident permits.
CA.rainwater_note: Rainwater Capture Act 2012: rooftop capture needs no water right.
CA.income_tax_note: Includes 1% surcharge above $1M; plus 1.1% payroll tax.

CO.name: Colorado
CO.homeschool_note: Notice plus testing or evaluation in set grades.
CO.rainwater_note: Two barrels, 110 gal total, outdoor use only; rural exempt-well permit option.
CO.offgrid_note: Composting toilets allowed but septic usually still required; tiny homes on wheels treated as RVs.

CT.name: Connecticut
CT.homeschool_note: No notice now; new law effective 2027 under HSLDA challenge.
CT.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows few provisions; weaker statute.
CT.offgrid_note: Towns may require sewer connection; occupancy cannot be denied for alternative power.

DE.name: Delaware
DE.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
DE.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; nonresident permits rarely issued.

DC.name: District of Columbia
DC.homeschool_note: Notice and parent high-school diploma; no testing.
DC.right_to_farm_note: No right-to-farm statute; not a state.
DC.rainwater_note: Not covered by sources read; assumed allowed.

FL.name: Florida
FL.homeschool_note: Home-education statute needs notice and annual evaluation; umbrella school avoids both.
FL.carry_note: Permitless since July 1, 2023; open-carry ban struck Sept 2025.
FL.right_to_farm_note: 2022: losing plaintiff pays farm's costs and fees.
FL.offgrid_note: Sewer connection mandatory where available; composting toilet alone not enough.

GA.name: Georgia
GA.homeschool_note: Notice, parent diploma, and periodic testing required.
GA.right_to_farm_note: Standing limited to owners of affected property.

HI.name: Hawaii
HI.homeschool_note: Notice plus testing in set grades.
HI.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; permits valid only in issuing county.
HI.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows few provisions; weaker statute.

IL.name: Illinois
IL.carry_note: Permit required; permitless only for unloaded cased firearms.

IA.name: Iowa
IA.homeschool_note: Independent private instruction option needs no notice or testing.
IA.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows many provisions; broad statute.

KS.name: Kansas
KS.homeschool_note: One-time registration as private school; HSLDA lists periodic assessment.

KY.name: Kentucky
KY.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.

LA.name: Louisiana
LA.homeschool_note: Registered private school option: notice only, no testing.
LA.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows many provisions; broad statute.

MD.name: Maryland
MD.homeschool_note: Notice; no testing or qualifications listed.
MD.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; good-and-substantial-reason ended after Bruen.

MA.name: Massachusetts
MA.homeschool_note: Notice to local school committee plus periodic assessment.
MA.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; place and purpose limits remain.
MA.offgrid_note: Composting toilets allowed since 2016 with board of health approval; many towns mandate sewer.
MA.income_tax_note: Graduated; 4% surtax on income over about $1M.

MI.name: Michigan
MI.homeschool_note: Home-school option needs no notice or testing.
MI.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows many provisions; broad statute.

MN.name: Minnesota
MN.homeschool_note: Notice, parent qualifications, and annual testing.

MS.name: Mississippi
MS.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
MS.carry_note: Permitless in holster, sheath, or bag; other concealment needs permit.

MO.name: Missouri
MO.homeschool_note: No notice; HSLDA lists record-keeping/assessment requirement.
MO.carry_note: Permitless since Jan 1, 2017; open carry may be locally restricted.
MO.right_to_farm_note: Constitution Art. I Sec. 35 (2014) guarantees right to farm.
MO.offgrid_note: Many rural counties have no zoning or building codes; approved septic still required.

MT.name: Montana
MT.homeschool_note: Annual notice to county; no testing.

NE.name: Nebraska
NE.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.

NV.name: Nevada
NV.homeschool_note: One-time notice; no testing or qualifications.
NV.right_to_farm_note: NALC chart shows few provisions; weaker statute.
NV.rainwater_note: NRS 533.027: de minimis rooftop capture, single-family home, nonpotable use.

NH.name: New Hampshire
NH.income_tax_note: No wage tax; interest and dividends tax repealed 2025.

NJ.name: New Jersey
NJ.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; justifiable-need ended after Bruen; strict place limits.

NM.name: New Mexico
NM.homeschool_note: Notice and parent high-school diploma; no testing.
NM.carry_note: Permit required; unloaded concealed or loaded in vehicle allowed without.

NY.name: New York
NY.homeschool_note: Notice, mandated subjects, and annual assessment; likely rated high by HSLDA.
NY.carry_note: Formerly may-issue; NYC permits separate; many sensitive-place limits.
NY.rainwater_note: Large cisterns may need local permit.

NC.name: North Carolina
NC.homeschool_note: Notice, parent diploma, and annual standardized test.
NC.right_to_farm_note: Updated after 2018; defense failed in Smithfield hog cases.

ND.name: North Dakota
ND.homeschool_note: Notice, parent qualifications, and testing with exceptions.
ND.carry_note: Concealed only; carry state ID and inform police; open carry needs permit.
ND.right_to_farm_note: Constitutional right-to-farm (2012) reported; not confirmed this session.

OH.name: Ohio
OH.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.
OH.income_tax_note: Flat above $26,050 from 2026; local taxes excluded.

OK.name: Oklahoma
OK.income_tax_note: Graduated; brackets cut to three in 2026.

OR.name: Oregon
OR.homeschool_note: Notice plus testing in set grades.
OR.carry_note: Permit required; recognizes only CA, ID, NV, WA residents.
OR.rainwater_note: ORS 537.141(1)(h): rooftop capture exempt from water-right permit.
OR.offgrid_note: Farm/forest zoning sets 20-160 acre minimum parcels; composting toilets allowed since 1978.

PA.name: Pennsylvania
PA.homeschool_note: Home-education program: notice, parent diploma, annual evaluation and portfolio.

RI.name: Rhode Island
RI.homeschool_note: Notice; HSLDA lists no assessment requirement.
RI.carry_note: Formerly may-issue for municipal permits; AG permits also issued.

SC.name: South Carolina
SC.homeschool_note: Parent diploma required; association option avoids district notice and testing.

TN.name: Tennessee
TN.homeschool_note: Notice and parent diploma; testing only for independent option.
TN.offgrid_note: Composting toilets barred where running water exists unless wastewater system approved.

TX.name: Texas
TX.homeschool_note: No notice; home schools treated as private schools.
TX.carry_note: Permitless since Sept 1, 2021; handguns; holster for open carry.
TX.right_to_farm_note: Bars nuisance suits against operations running one year unchanged.
TX.rainwater_note: Sales-tax exempt equipment; HOAs cannot ban systems.
TX.offgrid_note: Few codes in unincorporated areas; composting toilets legal; rainwater may be potable.

UT.name: Utah
UT.homeschool_note: One-time notice; no testing or mandated subjects.
UT.rainwater_note: Two 100-gal containers unregistered; free registration up to 2,500 gal.

VT.name: Vermont
VT.offgrid_note: Composting toilets named in law; septic still likely; solar under 15 kW needs registration only.

VA.name: Virginia
VA.homeschool_note: Home-instruction option: notice plus annual evidence of progress.
VA.right_to_farm_note: Standing limited to owners of affected property.

WA.name: Washington
WA.homeschool_note: Notice, parent qualifications, and annual testing.
WA.carry_note: Permit required; permitless only during outdoor recreation.
WA.rainwater_note: Rooftop capture needs no water right; use on site.
WA.offgrid_note: Composting toilets allowed with health permit; some counties allow rainwater as drinking water.
WA.income_tax_note: No wage tax; 7%-9% tax on large capital gains.

WV.name: West Virginia
WV.homeschool_note: Notice and parent diploma; assessment depends on option.
WV.right_to_farm_note: 2019: plaintiff must own land within half mile; no punitive damages.

WI.name: Wisconsin
WI.homeschool_note: Annual notice; no testing or qualifications.

WY.name: Wyoming
WY.homeschool_note: No notice, testing, or qualifications; curriculum form optional.
